verdict: Organic profiles holding volume; paid channels remain off across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every lead and profile interaction came entirely from organic Google Business Profile activity — paid campaigns on Meta and Google Ads recorded zero spend and zero leads for the full 28 days. Combined, your three profiles logged 392 GBP actions this period, with O'Hare Precision leading at 184 actions, Forte Metals at 106, and Advance Grinding at 102. The week-over-week picture is mixed: Advance Grinding's profile momentum grew 52% in the last 7 days, while Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision both saw GBP activity soften, with Forte down 63% and O'Hare down 32% versus the prior 7-day period. We are monitoring the downward trends at those two locations closely and are focused on stabilising organic visibility while paid channels remain paused.
